title: monky rares
description: a small mod that adds some fun things
body:
**_A mod that adds some dimension bosses for each one and other mobs for a slightly more immersive and fun progression, some new armor and tool sets (some better than netherite). I am using a translator since I don't speak English. This mod has nothing to do with monkeys and is in its beta phase in version 0.1.0; it will be in mini release.  
They are not good models or textures, but they will soon look better!  
We also added wood types for each dimension and their different generation (custom crafting tables by wood). I hope you enjoy this mod!_**
